# Muhamad Rizal Fikri (Zall) - Portfolio & Developer Profile

> Muhamad Rizal Fikri is an Information Systems student at Telkom University and a software developer specializing in mobile app development (Flutter, Kotlin) and backend systems (Node.js, Express.js, Laravel, Next.js). He is a national medalist at LKS (IT Software Solution for Business) and serves as a Mobile Development Mentor at GDG on Campus Telkom University.

- **Frontend & Web**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3
- **IoT & Hardware**: ESP32 integration, Antares IoT Platform, MQTT, HTTP Telemetry
- **Tools & Workflow**: Git, GitHub, Postman, Docker basics, Linux

## Work Experience
- **Mobile Dev Mentor** @ GDG on Campus Telkom University (Dec 2025 – Present): Mentoring students in cross-platform mobile app development with Flutter, leading workshops, and conducting hands-on coding labs.
- **Backend Developer Intern** @ Telkom Indonesia - Antares (Jan 2025 – Apr 2025): Designed and deployed RESTful APIs using Node.js & Express.js for IoT sensor data ingestion (ESP32) into the Antares IoT platform.
- **Mobile Developer Intern** @ PT Chlorine Indonesia (Sep 2024 – Dec 2024): Developed employee attendance and shift management mobile apps using Kotlin and integrated them with backend REST APIs.
- **High School Student Ambassador** @ Admission Telkom University (Jun 2025 – Jan 2026): Represented Telkom University at national education expos, presenting academic programs and advising prospective students.

## Featured Software Projects
- **Semara Lombok AI - Mobile**: B2B hospitality guest tablet application built with Flutter & Android Native, featuring an AI concierge chatbot, real-time guest service requests, and hotel backend integration.
- **TB Care Mobile**: Healthcare monitoring app built with Flutter and Firebase for Tuberculosis treatment tracking, medication reminders, and patient-doctor communication. (https://github.com/alamsyahfirdaus/tb-care-mobile)
- **SIM UKK Mobile & Web Ecosystem**: Digital exam grading system for vocational schools consisting of a Kotlin mobile app, Laravel REST API, and Laravel Blade administrative web dashboard. (https://github.com/zall18/project_ujikom_sim_ukk_mobile)
- **Smart Green House Mobile**: Smart agriculture monitoring and control app built with Kotlin, interfacing with IoT sensors (temperature, humidity, soil moisture) via REST APIs. (https://github.com/zall18/smart-green-house-mobile)
- **Hadirin Backend**: Event lifecycle management and QR code digital attendance backend built with Node.js, Express.js, and Prisma ORM. (https://github.com/zall18/hadirin-backend)
- **Smart Presence Backend**: Location-validated biometric and GPS attendance tracking API service built with Express.js and JWT. (https://github.com/nasrielsidiq/smart_presence)
- **Jurnal Prakerin Mobile**: Internship daily journal and photo documentation tracking app for students built with Kotlin. (https://github.com/zall18/jurnal_prakerin)
- **Project Presensi**: Comprehensive attendance management system with shift scheduling and RFID/biometric hardware integration built with Laravel. (https://github.com/zall18/project_presensi)
